headline: Anthropic files for IPO at $965B valuation, topping OpenAI
summary: AI's money is splitting: valuations are soaring, but building costs are crashing. Anthropic's IPO filing at $965B valuation, DeepSeek's permanent 75% discount, and OpenCode's rise as the most-used coding agent.
details: Anthropic has filed confidentially for an IPO with a staggering $965 billion valuation, surpassing OpenAI for the first time after a $65 billion raise. This move signals a major shift in the AI landscape, potentially impacting subscription costs and rate limits for users of AI labs.

In a follow-up to earlier discounts, DeepSeek has made its 75% price cut on its flagship V4-Pro model permanent. This makes frontier-grade coding significantly cheaper, offering a cost-effective option for bulk processing tasks.
Developers should exercise caution with DeepSeek, as it is a Chinese-origin API. It's recommended to reserve it for tasks where sensitive or proprietary code is not a concern.

OpenCode has emerged as the most-used coding agent, surpassing Cursor with over 172,000 GitHub stars. This development, combined with DeepSeek's reduced pricing, allows developers to access powerful coding tools for a fraction of the cost of top-tier models from OpenAI or Claude.

The AI market is experiencing a dual trend: soaring valuations for major players like Anthropic and a significant decrease in building costs. This presents a unique opportunity for developers to leverage advanced AI tools more affordably than ever before.

Anthropic files for IPO at $965B valuation, bigger than OpenAI!
Plus, frontier coding is now 4x cheaper.

Anthropic has filed confidentially for an IPO with a staggering $965 billion valuation, surpassing OpenAI for the first time after a $65 billion raise. This move signals a major shift in the AI landscape, potentially impacting subscription costs and rate limits for users of AI labs.

In a follow-up to earlier discounts, DeepSeek has made its 75% price cut on its flagship V4-Pro model permanent. This makes frontier-grade coding significantly cheaper, offering a cost-effective option for bulk processing tasks.

Developers should exercise caution with DeepSeek, as it is a Chinese-origin API. It's recommended to reserve it for tasks where sensitive or proprietary code is not a concern.

OpenCode has emerged as the most-used coding agent, surpassing Cursor with over 172,000 GitHub stars. This development, combined with DeepSeek's reduced pricing, allows developers to access powerful coding tools for a fraction of the cost of top-tier models from OpenAI or Claude.

The AI market is experiencing a dual trend: soaring valuations for major players like Anthropic and a significant decrease in building costs. This presents a unique opportunity for developers to leverage advanced AI tools more affordably than ever before.
